fusions.name: Mile's-End Lash
fusions.desc: A full-length lash at an enemy up to 7 tiles away deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, up to 1.5 times its damage at maximum range. Its damage also rises with the distance you have travelled before you swing.

fusions.name: Boot Follows Through
fusions.desc: A crack and a kick deal 12 damage, knock the target back 3 tiles and leave it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Drover's Tempo
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 20 seconds, and you move 15% faster for the first 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Paved Stride
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your damage rises by 12%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
